set.evidence: "we continue to forecast the margin dilution from the ramp-up of overseas fabs in the next several years to be between 2% to 3% in the early stages and widen to 3% to 4% in the latter stages." (4Q25 call, 15 Jan 2026, TSMC IR transcript); repeated verbatim in substance on the 3Q25 (16 Oct 2025) and 1Q26 (16 Apr 2026) calls

"the initial ramp-up of our two-nanometer technology will start to dilute our gross margin in the second half of the year, and we expect between 2% to 3% dilution for the full year of 2026." (4Q25 call, 15 Jan 2026, TSMC IR transcript); repeated on 1Q26 call (16 Apr 2026)

"the CapEx dollar required to build 1k wafer-per-month capacity of N2 is substantially higher than 1k wafer-per-month capacity for N3. The CapEx-per-k cost for A14 will be even higher (added by company after the call)." (4Q25 call, 15 Jan 2026, TSMC IR transcript, p. 4)
